rationale: The plan targets exactly the right estimand: a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition+time+condition:time against ~condition+time, with per-time-point Wald contrasts built from the already-fitted full model to characterize the trajectories, and it correctly notes the 3-df omnibus nature of the interaction. QC (VST PCA, sample-correlation heatmap colored by condition and time, balance cross-tab) precedes modeling, though no explicit outlier-handling policy or library-size check is stated; the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, tied to the smallest group size) is minimal and justified, and normalization stays inside the model with VST used only for visualization. Weaknesses: coding time as an ordered factor would switch DESeq2 to polynomial contrasts and complicate the resultsNames-based per-time-point contrasts, the reference level is never stated, and no LFC shrinkage (lfcShrink) is specified for the reported per-time-point effects. Enrichment correctly uses the tested-gene universe with BH q-values but omits collection version and gene-set size window; reporting covers design, thresholds, significant-gene counts and caveats but never mentions software versions.
